title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, billing qualifications and documented controls are supported. Both API calls match Microsoft's documentation, including the allocation request body and the consumption endpoint's deprecation warning. Targeted searches did not identify a documented switch dedicated to the agent node.
